vulnerability.explanation: Fixed-width, space-padded archive header fields (e.g., ar_date, ar_uid, ar_gid, ar_mode) are passed directly to strtol without a terminating NUL or a bounded length. The macro call buf->stelt = strtol(hdr->arelt, &aloser, size) can read past the end of the specific field into subsequent struct members until a non-digit is found. A crafted archive header filled with digits across adjacent fields can cause strtol to read beyond the field’s bounds, resulting in an out-of-bounds read.
